statement: If n ≥ 2 follows OOEOOE, then T_OOEOOE(n) < n^2 because x^{64} ≤ n^{81} forbids n^2 ≤ x. If n follows OOEOOEO, then the next image is < n^2 because z^{128} ≤ n^{243} forbids n^2 ≤ z. On MinimalNonTerm n the OOEOOE landing is odd, and the forced next O is followed by another O: an even landing or an even next image below n^2 is descent. The argument does not use a CycleMin return image = n. This is not a proof that escape is impossible, not a Z5 family, not a length-11 census, and not a halt theorem.
